_comment_docs_retrieval: Docs-retrieval wiring, written by `autonomous-sdlc-harness init` only when `docs.retrieval` is on, and merged rather than overwritten on a re-run. The program is this repository's own docs-search-server.sh, in its configured scripts directory, which finds the machine-shared retrieval runtime `init` installed, so nothing is fetched at run time and no machine path is committed here. The generated permission profile starts this server and allows its one tool; turning retrieval on after that profile was written needs `init --force` to reach it.
